items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His name is Alex. He’s 12 years old now

ctx.x: And you’ve got a grandchild, too?

His name is Alex. He’s 12 years old now, and these are just silly pictures from when he was younger. The my sister-in-law’s name is Julia. She’s got her doctorate degree in engineering. She can take her car motor apart and put it back together, and turn the key and it will probably start.
